map.GCS ≤8 分时咽喉反射显著减弱、误吸与气道梗阻风险急剧升高，难以维持有效通气: Below GCS 8 the gag reflex is markedly reduced and aspiration and airway obstruction risk rises sharply, making effective ventilation hard to maintain, so most guidelines take GCS <=8 as an indication for airway protection by intubation. But this is an empirical threshold and still needs breathing rhythm, oxygenation, possible airway injury and sedation/paralysis to be weighed together; the score alone can mislead (as with alcohol intoxication or post-sedation scoring).

map.要看这 1 分来自哪一项。若仅因「女性」得 1 分（即无其他危险因素），属真正的: Look at where that 1 point comes from. If it is only for "female sex" (no other risk factors) the patient is genuinely low risk and usually needs no anticoagulation; if it comes from hypertension, diabetes, heart failure or another substantive risk factor, men may consider anticoagulation while women are generally advised to take it. Guidelines also stress weighing bleeding risk (such as the HAS-BLED score), and the final decision rests with the physician together with patient preference.

map.：GCS 默认 E4+V5+M6 = 15，判轻度意识障碍。CHA₂DS₂-VA: : GCS defaults to E4+V5+M6 = 15, indicating mild disturbance of consciousness. CHA₂DS₂-VASc heart failure + hypertension + age >=75 = 1+1+2 = 4, high risk, so oral anticoagulation is advised. CURB-65 with 3 items = 3 points, high risk (30-day mortality about 17%), needing admission and ICU assessment. For MELD note: this tool implements 0.957·ln(bilirubin) + 0.378·ln(creatinine) + 1.120·ln(INR) + 0.643, whose coefficients are about one tenth of the textbook formula and with the bilirubin and creatinine coefficients swapped, and the result is clipped by the lower bound 6 - with bilirubin 2.0 mg/dL, creatinine 1.0 mg/dL, INR 1.2 and Na 140 mmol/L the tool gives MELD-Na = 6 while standard MELD = 3.78·ln(bilirubin) + 11.2·ln(INR) + 9.57·ln(creatinine) + 6.43 = 11.1; another set (bilirubin 5.0, creatinine 2.0, INR 1.8, Na 130) gives 15 on the tool versus 25.7 standard. For clinical and transplant assessment follow the standard formula or a hospital/UNOS system; this tool is for trend demonstration only.
map.：①GCS = 睁眼 E(1-4) + 语言 V(1-5) + 运动 M(1-6: : ①GCS = eye opening E(1-4) + verbal V(1-5) + motor M(1-6), total 3-15; >=13 mild, 9-12 moderate, <=8 deep coma (needs airway protection and urgent imaging). ②ASA classes I–VI with reference perioperative mortality <1% / 1-5% / 5-10% / 10-50% / >50%, with emergency surgery (E) raising risk further. ③CHA₂DS₂-VASc: heart failure 1, hypertension 1, age >=75 counts 2, diabetes 1, stroke/TIA counts 2, vascular disease 1, age 65-74 counts 1, female sex 1; 0 low risk (usually no anticoagulation), 1 moderate, >=2 high risk (anticoagulation advised, warfarin target INR 2-3). ④CURB-65: altered consciousness, urea >7 mmol/L, respiratory rate >=30/min, hypotension (systolic <90 or diastolic <=60) and age >=65 count 1 each; 0-1 outpatient (30-day mortality about 1.5%/3.2%), 2 hospitalise (3.9%), >=3 high risk (17%/40%/57%). ⑤MELD see the worked example below.
